latest_release.body: ## What's Changed * chore: release 0.1.1-54 by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/965 * feat(cli): ship README and icon in the package for the Store by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/956 * fix(scripts): honor `@asyar.mode silent` by suppressing success notifications (#941) by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/966 * feat(sdk): add optional `background` flag to shell.spawn for quiet runs (#939) by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/967 * feat(scripts): add settings to hide successful script notifications and rows (#940) by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/968 * fix(runs): release output buffers when history entries are evicted or cleared by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/969 * fix(linux): fix post-onboarding Wayland reveal and surface asyar-summon binding guide (#960) by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/972 * chore(deps): bump the cargo group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/970 * fix(sync): preserve pulled records on push failure and harden paywall handling by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/973 * test(crypto): prove OS keychain persistence across CI platforms by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/974 * feat(sync): add automatic device-key e2ee launcher core and pairing by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/975 * Feat/e2ee device key UI by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/976 * Feat/native-media-control-service by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/977 * feat(calendar): add native calendar and reminders service with EventKit by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/979 * feat(shortcuts): add native Apple Shortcuts service by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/980 * Resolve icons once in Rust and render them with one component (#949 step 1) by @BennoCrafter in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/964 * fix(search): keep an alias match above inline file results (#978) by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/981 * Feat/settings-sidebar-redesign by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/984 * fix(storage): migrate runs_history.quiet_success and demote DB errors from fatal by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/985 * fix(linux): prevent AppImage crash on COLRv1 colour fonts by @abdelrahman-alshurafa in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/983 * Feat/scheme-response-builder by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/988 * feat(cli): add asyar pack to build an installable .asyar locally by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/989 * feat(ai): add web search engine SPI for Tier 2 extensions by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/990 * feat(ai): add AI model & inference providers SPI for Tier 2 extensions by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/992 * docs: document AI model & inference provider SPI and add how-to guide by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/994 * feat(ai): add web content scraper / markdown reader SPI for Tier 2 ex… by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/993 * Add the object form of extension icons and align action panel icons (#949 step 3) by @BennoCrafter in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/991 * feat(files): add cloud & remote drive file search SPI for Tier 2 exte… by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/996 * Remote icons no longer reach as https:// URLs. The host fetches by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/997 * fix(network): return binary fetch bodies as base64 by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/998 * docs: document remote extension icons and correct stale CSP references by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pull/1001 * fix(macos): shield Cocoa delegate boundaries and prevent crash report overwrites by @Xoshbin in https://github.com/Xoshbin/asyar/pul
